title: Pages is your new Notion in DOTS
summary: DOTS turns AI into your project assistant. Ask it to create a workspace for any project, and it instantly generates notes, checklists, and sub-pages, all contextualized to what it knows about you. One prompt: "create a new sub page in the scratch pad for a video I'm making about the launch of dots." Seconds later it had the page built out with notes, checklists, and links back to past chats on the topic. If you've used Notion, Pages feels familiar, except your dot fills it in for you.
author: Futurepedia

title: DOTS is your new schedule master.
summary: DOTS can run recurring tasks, triggers, and reminders. Example: "Tomorrow is OpenAI's Dev Day. Review the main keynote. As soon as it's finished, give me a summary of everything they launched." Scheduled tasks can fire from a form entry, an incoming email, a weekly cadence, or a one-off in the future, all routed straight to your dot.
